Container.Name: tdarr-review
Container.Overview: Review Tdarr transcodes before replacing originals. A guided process combines picture, audio and synchronized video samples with saved manual checks. Approve completed assessments individually or in batches, record rejection reasons and track savings. Optional manual Radarr replacement requests preserve the original in quarantine. Czech and English interfaces. Linux amd64. Requires a separately installed Tdarr server, its DB2 directory and a separate folder containing completed results. Set PUBLIC_ORIGIN and TDARR_URL for your server before installing. Optional Recovery runs inside this container and is Off by default (RECOVERY_MODE). Approval writes to your media library.
Container.Requires: Linux amd64; Tdarr server; readable DB2 directory; completed transcodes in a separate writable review directory. UID 99 / GID 100 must have access to the selected host mappings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tdarr review transcode approval radarr quarantine

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for Review. If changed, update PUBLIC_ORIGIN to the exact browser URL.

Config.Name: Browser origin (required)
Config.Description: Enter the exact origin used in your browser, for example http://YOUR_UNRAID_IP:8270. Include the selected host port; no trailing path.

Config.Name: Tdarr server URL (required)
Config.Description: Enter the Tdarr server API URL reachable from this container, for example http://YOUR_UNRAID_IP:8266. This is the server API port, not its WebUI port.

Config.Name: Application state
Config.Description: Persistent Review settings, access key, history and journals. Use one Review container per state directory. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: Media parent
Config.Description: Parent of your movie library. The default expects films in media/movies. Review needs write access for approval and quarantine outside the Plex library. Configure MEDIA_ROOT if your folder name differs.

Config.Name: Results awaiting review
Config.Description: Separate host folder containing completed Tdarr results awaiting approval. Never select the original movie library. Use your existing results folder if already configured.

Config.Name: Tdarr DB2 directory
Config.Description: Directory containing SQL/database.db and its WAL/SHM files, mounted read-only. Locate your actual Tdarr DB2 directory; do not map only the database file.

Config.Name: Recovery mode
Config.Description: Optional automatic repair of corrupted originals. off: Recovery does not run. verify: confirm corrupted originals without changing them. repair: repair confirmed corruptions within the configured limits. verify and repair also need /data/recovery/config.json. Applies after a container restart.

Config.Name: Movie root inside Review
Config.Description: Container path to your movie library inside the Media parent mapping. Configure the matching source roots used by Tdarr in Review Settings after login.

Config.Name: Result root inside Review
Config.Description: Container path to completed results, matching the Results awaiting review mapping.
